subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft/checklist after the final answer, instead of the current compact collapse summary?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a compact activity digest and the requested behavior adds public config plus a durable retention policy that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Accept default-off full-draft retention
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned finalization option while keeping the current compact collapse summary as the default and proving the visible Telegram flow.

options.title: Keep compact summary only
options.body: Decline full completed-draft retention for now and keep the current one-line summary plus separate final answer as the supported Telegram behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Treat checklist/full-draft retention as part of a broader cross-channel structured progress-card API so Telegram does not define the contract alone.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full-draft retention
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned finalization option while keeping the current compact collapse summary as the default and proving the visible Telegram flow.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey's recent merged commits define the current Telegram progress-window finalization policy this request would change.
